title: Boss: the ZAP report and the audit
summary: An audit of the account service found session fixation, legacy unsalted password hashes, and a ZAP baseline report full of warnings. Fix the sign-in, migrate hashes without a password reset, and make the scan clean.

steps.title: Audit findings, account service
body: AU-1  Session fixation: the sid issued to an anonymous visitor stays valid after sign-in and
becomes the user's session. Sign-out only deletes the cookie in the browser.
AU-2  12% of users still have legacy hashes: sha256$<hex>, unsalted. Migrate without forcing
a password reset: upgrade each hash when its owner next signs in.
WARN-NEW: Cookie No HttpOnly Flag [10010]          /prefs   prefs=dark

steps.title: AU-1: a new session at sign-in, ended on the server
prompt: Fix the hand-written sessions (`sessions` maps a session id to a user, `null` for anonymous):

- `POST /login`: on success, **remove** the session the request came with (if any), create a **new** random id for the user, and set it as `sid` with `HttpOnly`, `Secure`, `SameSite=Strict` and `Path=/`;
- `POST /logout`: remove the session **from `sessions`** as well as deleting the cookie;
starter: if (l.Username != "carol" || l.Password != "correct horse battery staple") return Results.Unauthorized();
ctx.Request.Cookies["sid"] is { } s && sessions.TryGetValue(s, out var u) && u is not null ? Results.Ok(new { user = u }) : Results.Unauthorized());
solution: var cookieOptions = new CookieOptions { HttpOnly = true, Secure = true, SameSite = SameSiteMode.Strict, Path = "/" };
if (l.Username != "carol" || l.Password != "correct horse battery staple") return Results.Unauthorized();
if (ctx.Request.Cookies["sid"] is { } old) sessions.Remove(old);   // the old id is worthless now
ctx.Request.Cookies["sid"] is { } s && sessions.TryGetValue(s, out var u) && u is not null ? Results.Ok(new { user = u }) : Results.Unauthorized());
template: {{CODE}}
static class DojoTests
static string Sid(HttpResponseMessage r, out string header)
header = r.Headers.TryGetValues("Set-Cookie", out var v) ? v.FirstOrDefault(c => c.StartsWith("sid=")) ?? "" : "";
return header.Length > 4 ? header[4..].Split(';')[0] : "";
static Task<HttpResponseMessage> Send(HttpClient http, HttpMethod m, string url, string? sid, object? body = null)
var msg = new HttpRequestMessage(m, url);
if (sid is not null) msg.Headers.Add("Cookie", "sid=" + sid);
if (body is not null) msg.Content = JsonContent.Create(body);
return http.SendAsync(msg);
public static async Task Run(HttpClient http)
await Dojo.TryAsync("Sign-in could be checked", async () =>
var planted = Sid(await Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/", null), out _);
Dojo.Check("an anonymous visitor gets a session id", planted.Length > 0, "no sid");
var login = await Send(http, HttpMethod.Post, "/login", planted, new { username = "carol", password = "correct horse battery staple" });
DojoWeb.Status("carol signs in", 200, login);
var fresh = Sid(login, out var header);
Dojo.Check("sign-in issues a new session id", fresh.Length > 0 && fresh != planted, header);
DojoWeb.Status("AU-1: the planted id does not give carol's account", 401, await Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/me", planted));
Dojo.Eq("the new id does", "carol", DojoWeb.Prop(await DojoWeb.Json(await Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/me", fresh)), "user"));

Dojo.Check("the cookie is HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite=Strict", header.Contains("httponly", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && header.Contains("secure", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && header.Contains("samesite=strict", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase), header);
await Send(http, HttpMethod.Post, "/logout", fresh);
DojoWeb.Status("AU-1: after sign-out the old id is dead on the server", 401, await Send(http, HttpMethod.Get, "/me", fresh));
hints: At sign-in: `if (ctx.Request.Cookies["sid"] is { } old) sessions.Remove(old);`, then always a `NewId()`.
One `CookieOptions` with `HttpOnly = true, Secure = true, SameSite = SameSiteMode.Strict, Path = "/"`, used every time the cookie is set.

steps.title: AU-2: upgrade legacy hashes at sign-in
prompt: `HashPassword` and `VerifyPassword` from the lesson are given. Write `(bool Ok, string Stored) SignIn(string password, string stored)`:
- `stored` like `sha256$<lowercase hex>` is a legacy hash: compare `SHA256` of the UTF-8 password (in constant time). If it matches, return `(true, HashPassword(password))`: the new hash to save;

- `stored` in the `pbkdf2-sha256$...` format: verify it. If it matches and its iteration count is below 600,000, return a fresh `HashPassword(password)`; if it matches at full strength, return `(true, stored)` unchanged;
- a wrong password, or any other format: `(false, stored)` unchanged.
starter: (bool Ok, string Stored) SignIn(string password, string stored)
if (parts.Length != 4 || parts[0] != "pbkdf2-sha256" || !int.TryParse(parts[1], out var iterations) || iterations < 1) return false;
var actual = Rfc2898DeriveBytes.Pbkdf2(password, salt, iterations, HashAlgorithmName.SHA256, expected.Length);
solution: (bool Ok, string Stored) SignIn(string password, string stored)
if (parts.Length != 4 || parts[0] != "pbkdf2-sha256" || !int.TryParse(parts[1], out var iterations) || iterations < 1) return false;
var actual = Rfc2898DeriveBytes.Pbkdf2(password, salt, iterations, HashAlgorithmName.SHA256, expected.Length);

require.message: Compares the legacy hash in constant time too

template: {{CODE}}
var legacy = "sha256$" + Convert.ToHexStringLower(SHA256.HashData(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("sunshine1")));
var (ok1, up1) = SignIn("sunshine1", legacy);
Dojo.Eq("a legacy hash with the right password signs in", true, ok1);
Dojo.Check("...and comes back upgraded to PBKDF2", up1.StartsWith("pbkdf2-sha256$600000$") && VerifyPassword("sunshine1", up1), up1);
Dojo.Eq("a legacy hash with the wrong password is refused, unchanged", (false, legacy), SignIn("sunshine2", legacy));
var weak = "pbkdf2-sha256$1000$" + Convert.ToBase64String(new byte[16]) + "$" + Convert.ToBase64String(Rfc2898DeriveBytes.Pbkdf2("sunshine1", new byte[16], 1000, HashAlgorithmName.SHA256, 32));
var (ok2, up2) = SignIn("sunshine1", weak);
Dojo.Check("a low-iteration PBKDF2 hash signs in and is upgraded", ok2 && up2.StartsWith("pbkdf2-sha256$600000$"), up2);
Dojo.Eq("a full-strength hash signs in and is kept", (true, up1), SignIn("sunshine1", up1));
Dojo.Eq("an unknown format is refused", (false, "md5$abc"), SignIn("sunshine1", "md5$abc"));
hints: Legacy: compute `Convert.ToHexStringLower(SHA256.HashData(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(password)))` and compare its bytes with the stored hex using `CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals`.
PBKDF2: after `VerifyPassword` succeeds, read the iteration count from `stored.Split('$')[1]`.

steps.title: AU-3: make the baseline scan clean
prompt: - the `prefs` cookie set by `POST /prefs` is `HttpOnly` and `SameSite=Lax`;
- every response, errors included, has `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` (set it in `Response.OnStarting`);
- `GET /account/export` fails with a `500` problem details body, without the exception text (`AddProblemDetails` + `UseExceptionHandler` instead of the developer page).
starter: app.MapGet("/account", () => new { name = "Carol", address = "3 Test Lane, Testville" });
app.MapGet("/account/export", () => { throw new IOException("/mnt/exports/carol.csv: permission denied (user svc-export)"); });
solution: ctx.Response.Cookies.Append("prefs", "dark", new CookieOptions { HttpOnly = true, SameSite = SameSiteMode.Lax, Path = "/" });
return Results.Ok(new { name = "Carol", address = "3 Test Lane, Testville" });
app.MapGet("/account/export", () => { throw new IOException("/mnt/exports/carol.csv: permission denied (user svc-export)"); });
template: {{CODE}}
static class DojoTests
static string? H(HttpResponseMessage r, string n) => r.Headers.TryGetValues(n, out var v) ? string.Join(",", v) : null;
public static async Task Run(HttpClient http)
await Dojo.TryAsync("The scan could be repeated", async () =>
var prefs = await http.PostAsync("/prefs", null);
var c = H(prefs, "Set-Cookie") ?? "";
Dojo.Check("10010: prefs is HttpOnly", c.Contains("httponly", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase), c);
Dojo.Check("10054: prefs has SameSite=Lax", c.Contains("samesite=lax", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase), c);
var acc = await http.GetAsync("/account");
DojoWeb.Status("/account still works", 200, acc);
Dojo.Check("10015: /account is Cache-Control: no-store", (acc.Headers.CacheControl?.NoStore ?? false), acc.Headers.CacheControl?.ToString() ?? "(none)");
Dojo.Eq("10021: nosniff on /account", "nosniff", H(acc, "X-Content-Type-Options"));
var ex = await http.GetAsync("/account/export");
var body = await DojoWeb.Text(ex);
DojoWeb.Status("/account/export is a 500", 500, ex);

Dojo.Check("90022: no exception text, paths or account names", !body.Contains("/mnt/exports") && !body.Contains("svc-export") && !body.Contains("IOException"), body.Length > 300 ? body[..300] : body);
Dojo.Eq("...but a problem details body", "500", DojoWeb.Prop(await DojoWeb.Json(ex), "status"));
Dojo.Eq("10021: nosniff on the error too", "nosniff", H(ex, "X-Content-Type-Options"));
hints: `new CookieOptions { HttpOnly = true, SameSite = SameSiteMode.Lax, Path = "/" }` for the cookie; `ctx.Response.Headers.CacheControl = "no-store";` in the account endpoint.
`ctx.Response.OnStarting(() => { ctx.Response.Headers.XContentTypeOptions = "nosniff"; return Task.CompletedTask; })` in a middleware placed before `app.UseExceptionHandler()`.
